title: Organize Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Organize module.

files_audited.description: Total files examined across all audit dimensions.

orphans_found.description: Files with no referencing artifact and not declared in framework.yaml.

naming_violations.description: Files that do not follow the naming convention for their location.

depth_violations.description: Files more than 4 directory levels below project root.

duplicates_found.description: Files with matching content hash or duplicate schema title.

actions_taken_auto.description: Auto-repair actions completed without human input.

actions_requiring_confirmation.description: File paths where human confirmation is required before action is taken.

organize_report_path.description: Path to the organize report. e.g. .wabblespec/organize/report-<timestamp>.md
